variants.kind: diagnostic null of O1 and O2 (judges nothing); counted as ONE trial (12 of 15)
variants.rule: within each sleeve and each year 2019-2021, the hour-band (resp. weekday) labels of the chain trades are permuted at random (cell sizes kept), the perfect-foresight multipliers of O1 (resp. O2) recomputed on the permuted labels, and the pooled fp weekly Sharpe ratio at equal swing recorded; 500 permutations per dimension, numpy seed 20261112
variants.reading: share of permutations whose ratio reaches the real O1 / O2 ratio = how unusual the real clock structure of the out-of-fold years is; the null median = the part of the bound that any labelling would give (noise of the year)
